event_description: User submits a question to the Talkback AI assistant on the Patchbay.
An error occurred while the Talkback AI assistant was processing a response.
The Talkback monitor panel was closed by the user.
User clicked one of the pre-defined suggestion chips in the Talkback panel.
User clicked on a service module tile to open the associated service URL.
User clicked a specific jack (TUNNEL, LAN, or TS) link on a service module.
User clicked on a documentation tape to navigate to a project docs section.
User clicked an external offsite link from the Patchbay footer links section.
User typed a search query in the Patchbay filter strip to find services.
